Name: Jungle Blocks
Overview: Jungle Blocks is a Breakout variant in which the player controls a paddle located at the bottom of the screen. The paddle moves horizontally to deflect a ball upward toward destructible blocks. The objective in each level is to eliminate all blocks using the ball’s trajectory. Unlike traditional versions, this game does not impose a limit on lives; when a ball falls past the paddle, it results in a point deduction rather than a game over. Points are awarded for each block destroyed, and a score multiplier is applied when multiple blocks are broken in succession without the ball returning to the paddle. There are 14 levels and a co-op mode.
